title: Kyousenshi na Mob, Mujikaku ni Honpen wo Hakai Suru
titleRomaji: Kyousenshi na Mob, Mujikaku ni Honpen wo Hakai Suru
titleNative: 狂戦士なモブ、無自覚に本編を破壊する
synopsis: Albert, the youngest son of the border noble Falconer family, has a secret: he is a reincarnated person from another world. The Falconer family is one of the most skilled fighting families in the border, and he was raised on the battlefield from an early age. One day, at the age of 14, he realizes that this world is exactly like a game he played only once in his previous life. However, his memories of that game are vague. In the end, he was a "mob character" whose name doesn't even appear. As Albert begins to question the meaning of his existence, he decides to enroll at Radford Royal Magic Academy, the setting of the game...!? (Source: Futabasha, translated)

title: Maria the Virgin Witch
synopsis: As a war to determine the rightful ruler of medieval France ravages the land, it seems that the only hope for most, is protection from the heavens above through prayer. But deep in the forest outside of a small, bucolic village, the witch Maria will not stand idly by as men kill each other and commit horrendous acts in the name of God and glory. Using her powerful magic, she'll summon various beasts and demons—even going as far as using a succubus to seduce soldiers into submission under the veil of night—all to stop the needless slaughter. However, Maria's display of her magical might has drawn the ire of the Kingdom of Heaven and after the Archangel Michael puts an end to her meddling, he curses her to lose her powers if she ever gives up her virginity. Will she forgo the forbidden fruit of adulthood in order to bring an end to the merciless machine of war? (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: The Journey of a Dark Elf with Fading Powers
titleEnglish: The Journey of a Dark Elf with Fading Powers
titleNative: 魔力枯れのダークエルフ
synopsis: What she saw after losing her powers was the true beauty of the world... Amira, once hailed as the "omnipotent caster," has fully exhausted her magic force, making her just a regular dark elf. Once, she illuminated the world with her spells; now, she converses with the wind, kindles fire, leans how to cook, and searches for new meaning to her life. Quiet happiness and small miracles have taken the place of almighty magic in her life. What will she find in this second-life fantasy as she experiences rebirth after her loss? (Source: K MANGA)
